pod_farm.guide.animals.bison.body: Bison live in plains and love to eat wheat. Be careful, though; when the Bison gets hurt, it will become scared and attack you!
pod_farm.guide.animals.bison.title: Bison
pod_farm.guide.animals.body: Learn everything about the animals added in this Add-On.
pod_farm.guide.animals.crow.body: Crows will try to break your crops. You can build Scarecrows to scare them away!
pod_farm.guide.animals.crow.title: Crow
pod_farm.guide.animals.deer.body: Deer often hide in Forests, but sometimes, when looking for berries, they also come out onto plains or meadows.
pod_farm.guide.animals.deer.title: Deer
pod_farm.guide.animals.duck.body: Ducks prefer living near water. You will find them around rivers and swamps. Sometimes, they fly! They only come onto land to look for seeds to eat.
pod_farm.guide.animals.duck.title: Duck
pod_farm.guide.animals.goose.body: Geese have similar preferences as ducks. They also live in rivers and swamps! Unlike ducks, geese eat berries in addition to seeds.
pod_farm.guide.animals.goose.title: Goose
pod_farm.guide.animals.peacock.body: The Peacock, with its impressive feathers, can mainly be found in plains and forests, where it likes to eat Beans, Broccoli, Lettuce, and Kohlrabi.
pod_farm.guide.animals.peacock.title: Peacock
pod_farm.guide.animals.quail.body: If you find a strange, sparkling egg on the ground, there is likely a Quail nearby. You will find them pecking for seeds in savannas, deserts, plains, and forests.
pod_farm.guide.animals.quail.title: Quail
pod_farm.guide.animals.title: Animals
pod_farm.guide.animals.turkey.body: Turkeys live in relatively cold regions. You can find them in ice plains, taiga and snowy taiga biomes. They spend most of the day searching for berries and seeds to eat.
pod_farm.guide.animals.turkey.title: Turkey
pod_farm.guide.animals.yak.body: Yaks love the mountains and are commonly found in snowy slopes, frozen peaks, meadows and extreme hills. They eat wheat and are another source of milk. Be careful, though, they will become scared and attack you if they get hurt!
pod_farm.guide.animals.yak.title: Yak
pod_farm.guide.changelog.1.0.10: -Fixed Bean textures showing incorrectly%1-Fixed Peach Pie showing up as Apple Pie on the Plate%1-Fixed Apple Pie not showing up on the Plate%1-Fixed bone meal creating grass when used on plants in creative mode%1-Fixed Coconuts immediately breaking when spawning randomly in the world%1-Fixed Players not being able to open doors while holding seeds%1-Fixed the Cheeseburger recipe containing too much iron (and consuming a Bucket)%1-Fixed the dupe issue with Watering Cans when placed on specific blocks%1-Fire Aspect weapons now cook meat when used to kill an animal
pod_farm.guide.changelog.1.0.11: -Adjusted Mob Loot drops to match vanilla animals%1-Fixed Coconuts dropping items when naturally despawning%1-Yak & Bison can now be leashed%1-Fixed multiple plates being able to be stacked on one block%1-Fixed projectiles being able to break crops%1-Fix crops sometimes starting to float%1-Adjust Spawn Rates of different mobs%1-Added missing crafting recipes for all crops to be turned into seeds%1-Yak & Bison no longer break snow%1-Added a setting to disable mob trampling of crops and blocks
pod_farm.guide.changelog.1.0.12: -Added Cooking Pot%1-Added Cooking Pan%1-Added Fridge%1-Added Grill%1-Added Kettle%1-Added Oven%1-Added Stove%1-Added Toaster%1-Added Blender%1-Added Smoothies%1-Added Milkshakes%1-Added Toast%1-Added Cookbook%1-All drinks can now be placed on the ground%1-All tin cans can now be placed on the ground%1-All jars can now be placed on the ground%1-Added 'Kitchenware' Page to the Guide Book%1-Removed 'Furnace Recipes' Page from the Guide Book (Recipes can now be found in the Cookbook)%1-Removed 'Brewing Recipes' Page from the Guide Book (Recipes can now be found in the Cookbook)%1-Removed Food Items from 'Crafting Recipes' Page from the Guide Book (Recipes can now be found in the Cookbook)%1-Moved Popcorn to the Miscellaneous Food section the the creative inventory%1-Moved Cooked Corn to the Miscellaneous Food section the the creative inventory%1-Improved Crow Spawning Setting%1-Added a check that will despawn quail eggs if they are stuck
pod_farm.guide.changelog.1.0.8: -Peach Trees spawn rate increased%1-Grape Vines spawn rate increased%1-Corn now gets checked after placement%1-Changed every crops hit-box to be 1 block wide%1-Added crafting recipe to allow fruits to be turned into saplings%1-Reduced validation limit to 20 crops per player per validation. (performance optimisation)%1-Increased validations more frequent from 30 ticks -> 6 ticks. (performance optimisation)
pod_farm.guide.changelog.1.0.9: -Added Burgers%1-Added Plates%1-Added Watering Can%1-Added a crafting recipe for wool using cotton%1-Added a furnace recipe for cooked egg using quail eggs%1-Added a crafting recipe for black dye using black feathers%1-Added "Changelog" tab to the guide book%1-Added "Settings" tab to the guide book%1-Added another variant to the Yak%1-Converted Juicer to be a Block%1-Made crops compostable%1-Made quail eggs throwable%1-Made certain crops harvestable without having to break them%1-Realigned leash locator on certain animals%1-Overhauled plenty of textures%1-Fixed certain animals not being breedable using our seeds%1-Fixed certain animals being the wrong scale when growing up
pod_farm.guide.changelog.1.1.0: - All crops, bushes, and plants have been converted to blocks.%1- Trees now have wood, stripped logs, stripped wood, and leaves for every type of tree.%1- Crops are now affected by the gamerule 'randomtickspeed'.%1- Crops will now be destroyed when moved by a piston.%1- When using bone meal in creative mode, Crops will instantly grow to their final stage. In survival mode, bone meal will still act normally.%1- Fortune enchantment now works on crops.%1- We have added the setting 'Water Breaks Crops'. If you experience performance issues, we recommend disabling this setting.%1- Added Banana Cluster.%1- Trees are now complete block structures that can grow fruits on their leaves.%1- Bananas can now be used to place banana clusters on banana logs.%1- Trees will generate as complete structures worldwide, but only in unexplored chunks. (In existing worlds, all chunks, including those previously explored, count as unexplored chunks).%1- Updated Crow behavior.%1- Crows now no longer break trees added by our Add-On.%1- Crows now break base Minecraft crops, such as wheat.%1- Crops, bushes and plants will automatically convert to their block versions as you get close to them.%1- Trees WILL NOT convert automatically. Break them to receive their sapling and replant it.%1- WARNING: Entity-based crops and trees will be removed in a future update, so we recommend replacing them as soon as possible.
pod_farm.guide.changelog.1.1.1: - Fixed certain crops dropping seeds when being "picked"%1- Reduced amount of bananas dropped by banana cluster from 2-3 to 1-2%1- Reduced amount of sweet potatoes dropped from 3 to 2-3%1- Fixed certain crops not being "pickable" when the top block was clicked%1- The Grill can now be crafted using our custom logs%1- Fish can now be put on the plate%1- Fixed the 'Animal Spawning' setting not working%1- Reduced growth speed of saplings%1- Reduced growth speed of crops%1- Reduced growth speed of leaves%1- Reduced amount of fruit dropped by leaves from 2-3 to 1-2%1- Increased speed at which leaves decay%1- All custom log and wood types can now be turned into charcoal using a furnace%1- Added a button in the cookbook that allows the player to unpin recipes
pod_farm.guide.changelog.1.2.0: - Added Spirits%1- Added Spirit Hives%1- Added Palm Tree%1- Added Mustard Plant%1- Added Mustard Bottle%1- Added Sausage%1- Added Hotdog%1- Added various Honey Mustard Meat Types%1- Added Milk Chocolate%1- Added Dark Chocolate%1- Added Chocolate Spread%1- Added Chocolate Toast%1- Added Chocolate Cake%1- Trees, Bushes & Plants will now generate using Minecraft's Chunk Generation%1- Removed 'Crop Spawning' setting%1- Adjusted breaking time of wood to match vanilla
pod_farm.guide.changelog.1.2.1: - Water will now by default break crops.%1- Removed "Water Breaks Crops" Setting.%1- Crops will now be properly colored on maps.%1- Composting uses the new component from Minecraft now. This means items can also be composted using hoppers.%1- Crops will now return their seeds when middle clicked.%1- The following Item Groups were created for Inventory Menus and items were grouped accordingly: Tin Cans, Drinks, Ice Creams, Sandwiches, Spreads, Sushi, Toasts, Baked Desserts, Bowls, Kitchenware%1- Made fruit on player placed leaves grow more reliably.%1- Added correct tags to our logs in parity with vanilla logs.%1- Made quail eggs despawn more reliably after a baby quail spawned.
pod_farm.guide.changelog.1.3.0:
- New Italian Food! Various new pizza and pasta dishes and so many more
- New Plants! Added Basil, Garlic and Black Pepper
- New Trees! Added Olive, Pine and Pistachio Trees
- Added Salt, obtained by vaporizing water in cooking pot
- Added Spice Mills
- Added Pizza Oven
- Added Windmills in all wood variants
- Added wooden plate variant
- Added 3D models for all food items on plates
- Bowls and Ice Cream can now be placed in the world by sneaking while placing it
- Players can now eat from plates, bowls and eat ice cream placed in the world directly, by holding interact on them
- Food on plates and in bowls can now be seasoned using spice mills.
- Added command "/podfarm" for easier guidebook access
- Added command "/cookbook" for easier cookbook access
- Added Hunger information to cookbook
- Visually overhauled guide book and cookbook
- All saplings can now be put into flower pots.
- Guide Book and Cookbook can now be placed in chiseled bookshelf
- Renamed 'Tomato Chili Pasta' to 'Penne Arrabbiata'
- Renamed 'Pizza' to 'Margherita Pizza'
- Changed the method to remove items from Cooking Blocks to be 'interact'. This allows for better playability in creative mode
- You can no longer add food items to cooking blocks while sneaking and clicking on it.
- Fire charge can now be used to ignite the grill.
- Updated map colour of Peach Leaves
- Increased seed drop count on fully grown crops from 1 to 2. This reverts an accidental reduction from 2 to 1 prior to this in v1.2.1
- Improved rendering of leaves
- Changed nutrition of Bucket of Cheese from 6 to 5
- Changed Margherita Pizza crafting recipe to match other pizza crafting recipes
- Changed nutrition of Margherita Pizza from 14 to 8
- Changed Hawaiian Pizza crafting recipe to match other pizza crafting recipes
- Changed nutrition of Hawaiian Pizza from 16 to 15
- Fixed various items being consumed when used in creative mode
- Fixed the chocolate cake having an invalid icon in the cookbook
- Fixed pear sapling occassionally growing into a peach tree
- Added Compatibility with Biomes O' Plenty

pod_farm.guide.crops.apple.body: Apple Trees appear in §7Plains, Meadows §rand §7Forests§r.\n\nApple Wood can be converted to Oak Planks. The leaves will grow apples if they are connected to a wood block. Apples can be converted to Apple Tree Saplings.
pod_farm.guide.crops.apple.title: Apple Tree
pod_farm.guide.crops.avocado.body: Avocado Trees appear in §7Savannas §rand §7Jungles§r.\n\nAvocado Wood can be converted to Jungle Planks. The leaves will only grow avocados if they are connected to a wood block. Avocados can be converted to Avocado Tree Saplings.
pod_farm.guide.crops.avocado.title: Avocado Tree
pod_farm.guide.crops.banana.body: Banana Trees appear in §7Savannas§r and §7Jungles§r. Banana Wood can be converted into Jungle Planks. You can find banana clusters growing on the trees, which can be harvested by interacting with them once they are fully grown. Banana clusters can be replanted by interacting with Banana Wood while holding a banana. Bananas can also be converted into Banana Tree Saplings.
pod_farm.guide.crops.banana.title: Banana Tree
pod_farm.guide.crops.basil.body: Basil grows through seven stages and reaches a height of one block. It can be harvested by interacting with it once fully grown and can be planted on farmland or grass. Harvesting returns two basil seeds and one basil. A single basil can be converted into one basil seed, and basil seeds can also be obtained by breaking grass. Basil naturally appears in §7Plains§r, §7Forests§r, and §7Jungle Edges§r.
pod_farm.guide.crops.basil.title: Basil
pod_farm.guide.crops.bean.body: Beans grow through seven stages and reach a height of two blocks. They can be harvested by interacting with them once fully grown and are planted on farmland. Harvesting returns two bean seeds and one bean. A single bean can be converted into one bean seed, and bean seeds can also be obtained by breaking grass.

A single pineapple can be converted into one pineapple plant. Pineapple plants naturally appear in §7Jungles§r.
pod_farm.guide.crops.pineapple.title: Pineapple
pod_farm.guide.crops.pistachio.body: Pistachio Trees appear in §7Savannas§r.\n\nPistachio Wood can be converted to Dark Oak Planks. The leaves will grow pistachios if they are connected to a wood block. Pistachios can be converted to Pistachio Tree Saplings.
pod_farm.guide.crops.pistachio.title: Pistachio Tree
pod_farm.guide.crops.raspberry.body: Raspberry bushes grow through three stages and can be harvested by interacting with them once they are fully grown. They are planted using the raspberry itself and can be placed on grass or farmland. When harvested, raspberry bushes return between two and four raspberries. They naturally appear in §7Plains§r, §7Meadows§r, and §7Forests§r.
pod_farm.guide.crops.raspberry.title: Raspberry Bush
pod_farm.guide.crops.rhubarb.body: Rhubarb grows through seven stages and reaches a height of one block. It can be harvested by interacting with it once fully grown and is planted on farmland. Harvesting returns two rhubarb seeds and one rhubarb. A single rhubarb can be converted into one rhubarb seed, and rhubarb seeds can also be obtained by breaking grass.
pod_farm.guide.crops.rhubarb.title: Rhubarb
pod_farm.guide.crops.rice.body: Rice grows through seven stages and reaches a height of one block. It is planted on farmland and returns two rice seeds and one rice when harvested. A single rice can be converted into one rice seed, and rice seeds can also be obtained by breaking grass.
pod_farm.guide.crops.rice.title: Rice
pod_farm.guide.crops.spinach.body: Spinach grows through seven stages and reaches a height of one block. It can be harvested by interacting with it once fully grown and is planted on farmland. Harvesting returns two spinach seeds and one spinach. A single spinach can be converted into one spinach seed, and spinach seeds can also be obtained by breaking grass.
pod_farm.guide.crops.spinach.title: Spinach
pod_farm.guide.crops.strawberry.body: Strawberry bushes grow through three stages and can be harvested by interacting with them once they are fully grown. They are planted using the strawberry itself and can be placed on grass or farmland. When harvested, strawberry bushes return between two and four strawberries. They naturally appear in §7Plains§r, §7Meadows§r, and §7Forests§r.
pod_farm.guide.crops.strawberry.title: Strawberry Bush
pod_farm.guide.crops.sweet_potato.body: Sweet potatoes grow through seven stages and reach a height of one block. They are planted on farmland and return between two and three sweet potatoes when harvested. Sweet potato seeds can also be obtained by breaking grass.
pod_farm.guide.crops.sweet_potato.title: Sweet Potato
pod_farm.guide.crops.tea_plant.body: Tea plants grow through seven stages and reach a height of two blocks. They can be harvested by interacting with them once fully grown and can be planted on farmland or grass. Harvesting returns two tea plants and one tea. A single tea can be converted into one tea plant. Tea plants naturally appear in §7Savannas§r and §7Jungles§r.
pod_farm.guide.crops.tea_plant.title: Tea
pod_farm.guide.crops.title: Crops
pod_farm.guide.crops.tomato.body: Tomatoes grow through seven stages and reach a height of two blocks. They can be harvested by interacting with them once fully grown and are planted on farmland. Harvesting returns two tomato seeds and one tomato. A single tomato can be converted into one tomato seed, and tomato seeds can also be obtained by breaking grass.
pod_farm.guide.crops.tomato.title: Tomato
pod_farm.guide.crops.vanilla.body: Vanilla grows through seven stages and reaches a height of two blocks. It can be harvested by interacting with it once fully grown and is planted on farmland. Harvesting returns two vanilla seeds and one vanilla. A single vanilla can be converted into one vanilla seed, and vanilla seeds can also be obtained by breaking grass.
pod_farm.guide.crops.vanilla.title: Vanilla
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.Grill.body: Tired of cooked meat? Try grilling it on the Grill. Place the grill, fuel it with coal or charcoal, ignite it with flint and steel, and add your raw meat by clicking the grill. Once the meat is done, punch the grill to take it off. You can grill up to two pieces of meat at the same time.
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.Grill.title: Grill
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.blender.body: Make Smoothies, Milkshakes and Ice Cream using the Blender! Mix any food you want in your blender, click it with a glass bottle or an ice cream cone and take your food item out! Use milk or oat milk to make milkshakes, and combine a snowball with sugar to create ice cream!
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.blender.title: Blender
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.body: Kitchenware allows you to cook food in more unique ways than simply crafting it. It also offers additional recipes and is a great option for decorating your base.
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.cooking_pan.b: With the Cooking Pan, you can cook your favorite food items without using a furnace. Simply place the cooking pan on a stove, add your raw food, and wait for it to cook. Once the food is ready, punch the pan to take it out. You can also place the cooking pan anywhere else, but cooking will only work when it is on a stove.
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.cooking_pot.b: The Cooking Pot allows you to prepare certain dishes. Place all required ingredients into the cooking pot, then wait for the dish to finish cooking. Once it is ready, click the pot with the container the dish is stored in to take it out. You can find all available Cooking Pot recipes in the cookbook. The cooking pot can be placed anywhere in the world, but it will only cook when placed on a stove.
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.fridge.body: The fridge keeps all of your food items fresh and cold. You can place two fridges on top of each other. While their inventories remain separate, they will connect to form a large fridge.
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.fridge.title: Fridge
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.juicer.body: The juicer can be used to turn fruits into nice and refreshing juices. Once crafted, place the juicer on the ground and click it with your fruits to turn them into juice! Once you have put enough fruit in the juicer, you can click it with a glass bottle and enjoy your fresh juice!
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.juicer.title: Juicer
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.kettle.body: Need a coffee or tea? Craft a kettle, place it on a stove, add water and the ingredient you want to brew, then wait for it to finish. Click the kettle with a glass bottle to take your drink out. You can brew up to three drinks at the same time. Each water bottle you add contributes one unit of water, and each drink you take out consumes one unit. You can also place the kettle anywhere in the world, but it will only brew drinks when placed on a stove.
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.kettle.title: Kettle
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.oven.body: The Oven is an alternative to the furnace which allows you to easily cook up to two food items at the same time! Click it with your raw food to put it in the oven and wait for it to be cooked, then you can punch the oven to take it back out!
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.oven.title: Oven
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.pizza_oven.bo: The pizza oven is an alternative way to make pizza. Place dough next to the pizza oven and flatten it by interacting with it. Once the dough is shaped, you can start adding ingredients. \n\nYou can cook known pizza recipes or create your own by adding any ingredients you like. When you are done topping your pizza, click the pizza oven to transfer it inside and begin cooking. Once the pizza is cooked to your liking, interact with the oven again to take it out. Be careful, though. If you leave the pizza in the oven for too long, it will burn and no longer taste good!
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.plate.body: Plates are a cool way to decorate your base by putting down any food item! Simply right click the plate with the item to put it on. Punch the plate to take it back out. A plate can be crafted using Quartz.
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.plate.title: Plate
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.spice_mill.bo: Spice Mills can be used to improve your food. Season food on plates by interacting with it. Using the right amount of spice will restore more hunger, but be careful. Adding too much spice will cause the food to restore less hunger instead. There are seven different spices you can use: chili, garlic, ginger, mustard, onion, pepper, and salt. \n\nTo add spice to a Spice Mill, first craft an empty Spice Mill as explained below. Then combine the empty Spice Mill with the spice you want to add in your crafting menu. You can also place Spice Mills on the ground. To do this, hold sneak while placing them. You can place up to two Spice Mills on the same block.
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.stove.body: The stove supplies power to cooking pots, pans, and kettles. Place it anywhere you like, then put the kitchenware you need on top of it to start cooking.
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.stove.title: Stove Top
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.title: Kitchenware
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.toaster.body: Turn your bread slices into toast by putting them in the toaster! The toaster can toast up to two bread slices at the same time. Click it to add a bread slice in, then once the bread slice is toasted, punch it to take it back out!
pod_farm.guide.kitchenware.toaster.title: Toaster
pod_farm.guide.main.book: If you lose the book, you can re-craft it with a book and a §awheat§r. You can also access this guide with the command §7/podfarm§r at anytime.
pod_farm.guide.main.intro: §rThe Farming Add-On adds 37 new crops, 160+ new consumables, 9 new animals, and much more! This book will teach you everything you need to know!
pod_farm.guide.main.support: For more detailed information and support, check out §o§shttps://pdcr.sh/farm§r
pod_farm.guide.main.title: FARMING Add-On
pod_farm.guide.misc.body: On this page you will find information about various helpful features and utilities in the Farming Add-On.
pod_farm.guide.misc.crafting_recipes.bod: This page covers all additional crafting recipes that were added by this add-on and cannot be covered on a feature specific page.
pod_farm.guide.misc.decorations.body: Many items can be placed to be used as decoration. Place any drink, ice cream, bowl, tin can, spice mill or jar on the ground to decorate your world! All other food items can be placed on plates and will have a 3D Model too!
pod_farm.guide.misc.decorations.title: Decorations
pod_farm.guide.misc.scarecrows.body: Crows love to eat your crops, but instead of scaring them away all day, you can build a scarecrow to protect your fields. A Scarecrow will scare away all crows within an 8 block radius. §lConstruction§r Start by placing a fence on the ground. Place a hay block on top of it, then add two fences to the sides of the hay block as arms. Finally, place a carved pumpkin on top to complete your scarecrow.
pod_farm.guide.misc.scarecrows.title: Scarecrows
pod_farm.guide.misc.spirit_hive.body: Place a Spirit Hive around your farm for spirits to spawn and harvest for you. When you place a block container above the Spirit Hive with seeds in it, spirits will take those seeds to plant new crops on empty farmland. Harvested items will be brought back to the hive and will be either dropped on the floor, or, if there is a block container below the Spirit Hive, they will be deposited into that container. The sides of a spirit hive should be left open as spirits will spawn here. A Spirit Hive can spawn up to 5 spirits. For Trees to be harvested, the trees need to be within a 15 block radius of the spirit hive. For all other plants to be harvested, they have to be within a 15 block horizontal radius, and a 2 block vertical radius.
pod_farm.guide.misc.spirit_hive.title: Spirit Hive
pod_farm.guide.misc.spirits.body: Spirits are little helpers in your world that will make farming easier for you. They spawn from spirit hives whenever there's something for them to do within a radius of 15 blocks. They will harvest or pick crops, bushes and fruits on trees and bring the loot back to their hive. Crops and Bushes need to be planted on farmland in order for spirits to interact with them!
pod_farm.guide.misc.spirits.title: Spirits
pod_farm.guide.misc.title: Miscellaneous
pod_farm.guide.misc.watering_can.body: The Watering Can allows you to make your crops grow faster! Interact with crops to water them, once your watering can is empty, simply click a water block to refill. Sneak while using your watering can to place it down.
pod_farm.guide.misc.watering_can.title: Watering Can
pod_farm.guide.misc.windmill.body:
The Windmill is a processing station used to produce oil, but also serves as great decoration. Put pine nuts, olives or wheat seeds in the windmill to produce oil, extract the oil by adding a glass bottle to the windmill by interacting with the millstone.

The Windmill is a multiblock structure and requires a clear 1x2 block of free space in order to be placed.
Additionally, the Windmill includes an extendable beam. Interact with the Windmill to extend the beam by one segment, and use Sneak + Interact to reduce the beam length. If you move 10 blocks or more away from the Windmill, the beam extension feature becomes disabled.

The millstone is located at the end of the Windmill's beam. You can insert items manually by interacting while holding a Glass Bottle or any of the ingredients. The millstone also supports automated input through a Hopper.
pod_farm.guide.misc.windmill.title: Windmill
